text:
nora: FYI — internal edge onboarding sample failing TS inference when SDK consumed as ESM. Generics on createClient become `any`.

kevin: any repro we can run?

nora: minimal tsconfig and snippet: 
```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {"module": "ESNext", "moduleResolution": "bundler", "strict": true}
}
```
```ts
import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference-js'
const client = createClient<{me:{id:string}}>({})
// client later has `any` type
```

tara: common causes: bad `exports`/types mapping, or an overload fallback that uses `any`. Do we re-export types through an intermediate `index.d.ts`?

nora: yes — we bundle types and re-export. package.json has `module` and `types` but no `exports.import.types`.

kevin: quick workaround for sample: add typesVersions or a local `types` entry in sample package.json pointing to `dist/esm/index.d.ts`. Ugly but works.

tara: longer fix: publish a types-only ESM entry under `exports` and tighten overloads so the generic signature is primary (remove `any` fallback). Also add a CI TS test building sample with `moduleResolution: bundler`.

ci-bot: Created issue #1432 (devex: esm-types-inference-collapse) and queued CI job to reproduce.

nora: I'll draft a PR with `exports.import.types` and overload cleanup. tagging tara for review. Thanks. :v:
